notes: kb/Work PB1196 LANDED (w61e). The floating-point arm of the arithmetic store (ArithmeticEmitter.StoreArith) now lands through FloatResultant: the value is rounded ONCE into binary32/binary64 under the receiver's §14.7.4.3 mode (cite.py OK §14.7.4.3 9)). Re-probed on the w61e build: TOWARD-LESSER 0.1 -> 0.0999999940 (was 0.10000000149, larger); -0.1 -> -0.10000000149. ⚠ DETERMINATION (CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-123): under native arithmetic an expression whose resultants are all floating-point evaluates in binary64, and that binary64 intermediate IS the arithmetic value the mode rounds; a binary64 resultant therefore holds it unchanged (COMPUTE D1 ROUNDED MODE IS TOWARD-GREATER = 1 / 3 equals the TOWARD-LESSER result), while an exact scaled/SDIDI value is rounded into either format once.
